_note: Colony needs: the daily tasks (docs/26-come-back.md). Each day (from dayStartsUtcHour, a real day at world speed 1) a player gets perDay needs, picked from the ones they can do. A need counts a stat (shared/src/stats.ts) from the moment it was given. Unfinished needs keep for keepDays days, then fade; there is no streak and nothing is lost by missing a day. rerollsPerDay swaps a need for another. The reward is rewardHours of the player's whole production (every colony), at least minReward, paid into the colony they pick. count is the goal; scale raises it by the player's highest Queen's Chamber level ([level, count], last match wins). unlock: when the need can be given, one of { chamber, level } (any colony), { units, count } (owned, home or away) or { stat, count }. weight: how often it is picked (default 1). {n} in the title is the goal.

needs.title: Bring home {n} forage parties
needs.hint: The colony is hungry for news from the wilds.

needs.title: Carry home {n} food
needs.hint: Anything that comes home on a party's backs counts: forage finds, loot, corpses, windfalls.

needs.title: Finish {n} digs
needs.hint: The queen's daughters want more room.

needs.title: Finish a piece of research
needs.hint: The colony learns from what it smells.

needs.title: Haul {n} Protein of corpses
needs.hint: Every fight leaves the dead on the field. Workers, Media Workers and Haulers can carry them home.

needs.title: Scout {n} places
needs.hint: Colonies, wild sites or the wilds: any scout report counts.

needs.title: Win a fight in the wilds
needs.hint: A wild nest, a termite mound, a spider den or a windfall.

needs.title: Claim a windfall
needs.hint: Watch for food lying in the wilds near you.

needs.title: Bring home {n} Nectar from aphid herds
needs.hint: Tended herds send honeydew home every few hours.
